Test name: TC-GEO-1248-012 - Other prompts feed InBrief and Top Topics of their category, the Overview and the Other page in an unbranded analysis
Test step: Given the Other-type prompt of C1 produced theme T1
Expected result: Its detail panel lists T1
QA Precondition: Staging https://staging-geo.onclusive.com/geo, user logged in with the QA account (role allowed to create analyses), interface language British English (en-GB). Organisation switcher set to the pool test organisation T (e.g. QA-GEO) with a prompt pool set in the back office and enough free slots for the scope used; P = pool and U = slots used by its existing analyses, read at execution on the dashboard pool block "U / P". Global unbranded / Other feature flag ON (5-step wizard: Analysis Type, Brand & Country or Topic & Country, Categories, Prompts, Summary). Analysis UA: unbranded analysis created with the wizard, topic "Postal services", markets GB (EN) and FR (FR), the 2 discovered categories C1 and C2 (e.g. "Parcel delivery" and "International shipping"), every suggestion kept, plus one custom prompt in C1 with an empty type (Other type) and one custom Visibility prompt with an empty category (Other category); daily collection, at least one collection completed. In the latest collection of UA, the Other-type prompt of C1 produced a theme T1 that no Category Topics prompt produced. InBrief = the block headed by the logo "InBrief powered by AI Sense" (rendered as an image, not as text), with a bullet list and a "… generated by artificial intelligence" footer.
